text: {"assertions":["A partial upload bug in storage/blob/uploader.rs was identified and fixed on 2026-02-11.","The bug manifested as a final upload part that never received acknowledgment when the input list was empty.","The root cause was a race condition in lazy initialization of the uploader.","The fix used a double-checked lock pattern to guard the initialization.","The fix was submitted in PR #1628 on the fix/partial-upload-1 branch.","The bug was reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled link.","After applying the fix, p99 latency improved from 2.6 seconds to 439 milliseconds."]}
